idea-plugin.name: Geo Viewer Plus
idea-plugin.description:
Geo Viewer Plus adds a dedicated interactive map for spatial values in DataGrip result grids. It is independent of DataGrip's built-in Geo Viewer and keeps map interaction connected to the current result set.

  • Display WKT-compatible points, lines, polygons, and multi-geometries from visible result-grid rows.
  • Select a row to focus and highlight its geometry; click a map feature to select and scroll to its row.
  • Switch between built-in OSM and domestic-friendly basemaps, or add custom XYZ/TMS sources with attribution and subdomains.
  • Persist the selected default basemap, inspect the actual tile zoom level, and retry failed tile requests without interrupting feature selection.
  • Use a compact, collapsible toolbar designed to keep the map and result grid visible together.

Map tiles are requested directly from the selected provider. Use only sources you are permitted to access, and review each provider's attribution and terms.
